title: Nine Lives of Winter
subtitle: 动物世界 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 动物世界（自然生态·动物世界）
meta: 主题语境：动物世界（自然生态·动物世界）　|　核心词汇：cat　|　正文 340 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 cat 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1953 my mother was sent to feed ① a cat she could not catch, and she said the catching was the whole of the lesson. The ② cat, meaning the animal and not the fur, was nine years old and was fed by whoever came last; a cat, she said, is the only thing in a kitchen that is judged by how much has been taken out of it.

Every ③ cat in that kitchen had the same saucer, and the ④ cat at the door, meaning the one the neighbour kept and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever fed properly. A cat, my grandmother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to stay behind; my mother said the patience is the part that gets everywhere.

My father meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ cat was the whole of the winter, meaning the season it filled and not the animal. The ⑥ cat, meaning the winter and not any of that, is the only thing in a house that everybody strokes and nobody questions; a cat, he said, is either something you feed or the only word that means both an animal and a winter. She said the winter is the part they remember.

By 1969 the ⑦ cat had become a photograph in a report, and the report had become an argument about the saucer. The ⑧ cat of the whole thing, my mother wrote in April, was nine years and eleven years of feeding; a cat, she said, is either the one at the door or the reason you learned to stand on a chair. He said the chair was never mentioned.

The ⑨ cat I remember is the one at the door, which was buried in 1974 and is still described as the best in the county. A ⑩ cat, my grandmother said in 1979, is the only thing that improves by being fed; every cat, she said, is a winter that has agreed to look like an animal. She said the winter was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: B. n. 猫（指那只动物本身，与皮毛相对）
C. 固定搭配：feed a cat 喂一只猫
D. n. 猫（指厨房里每一只）
E. n. 猫（指门口那一只）
F. n. 猫（抽象：它填满的那个冬天）
G. n. 那个冬天（抽象：那件事本身）
H. n. 权衡；整件事的分量（抽象总称）

items.q: a cat she could not catch
The cat, meaning the animal and not the fur
cat was the whole of the winter
the cat had become a photograph in a report
The cat of the whole thing
A cat, my grandmother said in 1979

answers.why: feed a cat 意为“喂一只猫”，1953 年母亲被派去喂一只她捉不到的猫。
cat 意为“猫”，指那只动物本身而不是皮毛，九岁，由最后走的人喂食。
cat 指厨房里每一只猫，每一只都是同样的碟子。
cat 指门口那一只（邻居养的那一只），是唯一有人认真喂过的。
cat 意为“猫”，抽象指它填满的那个冬天，父亲说 cat 就是那个冬天的全部。
cat 为抽象用法，指那个冬天本身，是屋子里人人都抚摸、却没人质疑的东西。
cat 意为“猫”，到 1969 年这只 cat 成了报告里的一张照片。
cat 意为“权衡、整件事的分量”，母亲四月写道，整件事权衡下来是九年和十一年的喂食。
cat 意为“猫”，我记得的是门口那一只，1974 年埋掉，至今仍被说成全县最好的。
cat 为抽象总称，祖母说猫是唯一会因为被好好喂养而变好的东西。
